outcome: Vasoconstriction response to Angiotensin II (amplitude of contraction, relaxation factor, time to maximal constriction, area under the pressure curve)
cohort: Term placentas obtained immediately after cesarean deliveries were used for ex-vivo perfusion experiments.
finding: Inflammatory stimuli significantly increased the vasoconstriction response to Angiotensin II in fetal placental blood vessels, indicating compromised vascular function, whereas acidosis did not have the same effect.
